swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The laws of reflection apply to concave and convex mirrors as well as plane mirrors. Reason (R): at every point on a curved mirror, the reflected ray still makes an angle of reflection equal to the angle of incidence measured from the normal at that point.

add.q: Assertion (A): The laws of reflection apply to concave and convex mirrors as well as plane mirrors. Reason (R): More than 800 years ago, around the time of the Indian mathematician Bhaskara II, astronomers used shallow bowls of water to observe stars and measure their positions. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
